title: JOYOR F5 City Commuter Electric Scooter

details.title: Vibrant Display, Total Control
details.content: The electric scooter features a high-definition, colorful display that keeps you informed in real-time. It shows live speed, battery level, and riding mode, allowing you to easily monitor your ride and stay in control throughout your journey.

details.title: Powerful Urban Ride
details.content: The 500W rear drum brake motor offers strong performance, making it easy to tackle urban hills with a 15° climbing angle.

details.title: Ride Farther, Explore More
details.content: The 48V 10.4Ah battery offers reliable power and a range of up to 38 km, perfect for city commuting and longer rides.

details.title: High-response disc brake system
details.content: Urban commuting is smoother with built-in spring shock absorption, efficiently filtering bumps. The front shock system enhances stability, ensuring a safe, reliable ride.

details.title: Foldable and portable
details.content: The JOYOR F5 e-scooter has an unfolded size of 985*540*1170mm and a folded size of 945*540*330mm. It weighs 14.25kg and is easy to transport and store. It is an ideal choice for commuting to work, school, or short trips.
8 inch front pneumatic tires and rear solid tires.All-terrain tire tread, with stronger grip
